sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: part:370010 – proposal for the coming period
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation and for reviewing our requirements. We would very much like to continue working with Werdenfels and appreciate your consideration of a longer-term arrangement.

Would you kindly consider EUR 4.60/kg for part:370010, with payment within 30 days net and a 36-month contract? We propose AS-14404 on a 45% material share, with a 0% deadband and base month 2026-08. Our requirement is 23,700 kg/year, DAP, with a 14-day lead time, effective from 2027-01-01 and no tooling charges.

Our purchase orders with you for part:370010 on 2 and 17 June 2026 were at EUR 5.26/kg (po:4500014022-10, po:4500014078-10), compared with EUR 5.84/kg on 1 and 18 September 2026 (po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10).

We recognise the cost pressures you described and hope that the longer commitment and proposed adjustment mechanism give us a useful basis for reviewing the starting price together. A 24-month commitment would also be possible if that suits your team better.

Could you kindly let us know what binding offer you can approve?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We appreciate your interest in a longer-term arrangement and acknowledge the historical purchase orders you referenced.

To provide a stable basis for both parties, we can agree to the AS-14404 index mechanism and a 24-month contract term as you suggested. With these adjustments, we can offer a revised price of EUR 5.40 per kg. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with a contract term of 24 months: a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Thank you for working through the options with us. We appreciate your team's careful review and would like to find an arrangement that works for Werdenfels as well as for us.

Could you kindly consider one of these complete alternatives? Each price is conditional on its payment term and adjustment clause.

Option A: EUR 5.07/kg, payment within 30 days net, a 36-month contract, AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband and base month 2026-08.
Option B: EUR 5.05/kg, payment within 14 days net, a 36-month contract, AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband and base month 2026-08.
Option C: EUR 5.10/kg, payment within 60 days net, a 36-month contract, AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband and base month 2026-08.

The fixed terms of our enquiry remain unchanged. These are new proposals for your approval. Could you issue the option you can approve as your binding offer? If none works, which term would need to change? We would be pleased to review it together.

Kind regards,
Purchasing

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your flexibility in providing these options and are pleased to build on your proposal for a 14-day payment term. 

As our distributor proposal, our offer stands at a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

In exchange for the shorter payment term and the 36-month contract, we can reduce our price to EUR 5.30 per kg. This represents a significant step towards your target while maintaining a sustainable basis for our production. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €5.30 per unit. As an option, a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404 is available. 

We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: part:370010 – 14-day payment package
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for moving to EUR 5.30/kg and for offering the AS-14404 clause with a 5% deadband. We appreciate the effort your team has put into this.

Since you would like to build on the 14-day payment term, we would like to focus on the package we proposed with it: EUR 5.05/kg, payment within 14 days net, a 36-month contract, AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband and base month 2026-08, with all fixed enquiry terms unchanged.

AS-14404 changed by -5.49% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). We recognise this recent window sits alongside the annual rise you mentioned. The AS-14404 clause in this package would adjust the material share if the index moves significantly over the term.

Could you issue this package as your binding offer? If not, could you let us know whether the price or another element prevents approval? Could your pricing committee or owner review this specific package?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

It is always a pleasure working with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. We have verified the recent decrease in the AS-14404 index from June to September 2026 that you highlighted. While your target price remains unfeasible, we can pass on the cost reduction and adjust our offer to EUR 5.20 per kg.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Specifically, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. Furthermore, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.

For our current Angebot, we present a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer is based on the 14-day payment term and 36-month contract with the AS-14404 adjustment clause. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Part 370010 – approval of the 14-day package
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for reviewing the AS-14404 development and for moving to EUR 5.20/kg. We appreciate the effort you and your team have made and value our long cooperation with Werdenfels.

Unfortunately, we are not able to approve EUR 5.20/kg. We remain keen to agree the 14-day package we discussed: EUR 5.05/kg, payment within 14 days net, a 36-month contract and AS-14404 on a 45% material share with a 5% deadband and base month 2026-08. All fixed enquiry terms would stay unchanged.

Could you kindly let us know whether your pricing committee or owner is able to approve that specific package? If they can, we would be glad to receive it as your binding offer.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
